Oink 0.1.1 adds in-app updates, desktop notifications and more control over how your pointer moves between screens.

## Highlights

- **In-app updates** — check, download and install updates in Oink on Mac and Windows. Mac updates use Sparkle; Windows updates use signed manifests. Install interrupts sharing and restarts Oink immediately. If you use 0.1.0, install 0.1.1 manually once to get this feature.
- **Desktop notifications** — game-mode changes and pointer or keyboard locks appear on the affected computer, with Undo. Choose Off, Minimal, Default or Verbose in the Notifications setting.
- **Per-screen pointer speed** — adjust pointer speed when remotely controlling each screen, without changing local use or game mode.
- **Edge resistance** — keeping the mouse completely still at an edge for 100 ms releases the resistance for that edge visit.
- **Connection chart** — Settings now shows RTT P90, the 90th-percentile round-trip time, instead of jitter.

## Fixes

- Corrected cross-device dragging from displays placed above or to the left of the primary display, and the drag start position on Windows.
- Fixed the Dock staying visible after leaving an external display and false automatic game-mode entry.
- Corrected last-seen times and hidden-screen visibility for offline devices.
- Fixed overlays using the primary display's refresh rate on mixed-refresh-rate setups.
- Fixed edge resistance being bypassed across a gap between displays.
- Fixed audio forwarding failing to recover after packet loss.
- Fixed manual update checks being refused or getting stuck after a failed download.
- Improved reconnection after another computer restarts.
- Fixed startup when Oink is run as administrator or Windows UAC is off.
- Reduced idle CPU use from connection charts and layout animations.
- Removed the device-address-changed alert.

## Downloads

- **Mac:** the `.dmg` file — Apple silicon, macOS 14.2 or later. Developer ID signed and notarized.
- **Windows:** the `.msi` file — x64, Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045) or later, or Windows 11. Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen runtime (preinstalled on current Windows).

Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.

## Known limitations

- The Windows MSI is not code-signed in this release. SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info → Run anyway**. UAC shows an unknown publisher.

Please report problems in [Issues](https://github.com/oinkvm/oink/issues) with your environment, diagnostic data and steps to reproduce.
